AboutPreview.text1: Shimshal sits high in Upper Hunza, among some of the most dramatic mountains in Pakistan. Shimshal Heights gives trekkers, families and travellers a warm bed, a hot meal and a friendly welcome after the long road in.
AboutPreview.text2: We keep things simple: comfortable rooms, honest food and a team that knows the valley.
AboutPreview.text4: A place to rest at the edge of the Karakoram

CallToAction.text1: Your room in the mountains is waiting.
CallToAction.description: Send a booking request online and we will help you plan your stay.

Facilities.text1: Everything you need after a long day in the mountains

FeaturedRooms.text2: Rooms will appear here soon. Contact the hotel to ask about availability.
FeaturedRooms.text7: Rooms for every kind of stay
FeaturedRooms.text8: From a quiet double to a family room, all with heating and mountain views.

Hero.text2: Experience Comfort in the Heart of Shimshal.
Hero.description: Shimshal Heights is a mountain hotel with warm rooms, a restaurant serving fresh meals, and the high peaks of Hunza outside your window.

LocationSection.text1: The road to Shimshal is long and spectacular. Contact us before you travel and we will help with directions and arrival times.

RestaurantPreview.text5: Our restaurant serves breakfast, lunch and dinner, with room service when you would rather stay in.

ShimshalExperience.text2: One of the most remote valleys in Hunza, and one of the most rewarding to reach.
